reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_name, COUNT(cp.product_id) AS n_checks
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN competitor_prices cp ON cp.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.brand = 'Sonora'
GROUP BY p.product_name
alternatives: SELECT p.product_name, COUNT(cp.product_id) AS n_checks FROM competitor_prices cp RIGHT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = cp.product_id WHERE p.brand = 'Sonora' GROUP BY p.product_name

SELECT p.product_name, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.product_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS n_checks FROM products p LEFT JOIN competitor_prices cp ON cp.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.brand = 'Sonora' GROUP BY 1

other_way.sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.product_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS n_checks FROM products p LEFT JOIN competitor_prices cp ON cp.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.brand = 'Sonora' GROUP BY 1
other_way.tradeoff: SUM of a CASE gives the same counts and could count only some checks, but COUNT of a competitor_prices column is shorter.
